description: Reserve a listing for the signed-in buyer and get a one-time NEAR Intents deposit address and the exact amount to send. Nothing is charged by this call; the purchase completes when the buyer's wallet sends that amount. Needs a Port66 session.

chain.description: Optional chain when the asset exists on several, e.g. Arbitrum for ETH

pay_with.description: What the buyer pays with: BTC, SOL, NEAR, ETH, USDC, USDT, DOGE or LTC

refund_to.description: The buyer's own address on the paying chain; refunds go here

name: start_purchase
title: Start a purchase
